data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Regula Face SDK to compare faces and perform liveness detection.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to easily compare faces and perform liveness detection using the phone's camera. It wraps the Regula Face SDK framework for both Android and iOS.
use_when: You need face matching, recognition, or liveness detection in your mobile app.
You are using the Regula Face SDK ecosystem.
avoid_when: You only need basic barcode or QR scanning.
You require an open-source on-device face recognition solution without proprietary SDK dependencies.
strengths: Enables powerful face matching and liveness detection via phone camera.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Requires specific native platform versions (iOS 15+, Android 7.0+ API 24).
Depends on a proprietary commercial SDK (Regula Face SDK).
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 15+ & Android 7.0+ (API 24) and integration with Regula Face SDK native dependencies and documentation.
